title: Trading rights upload (BOW front end, TRADING_RIGHTS_UPLOAD)
purpose: What each client may do per category, exchange and market: one line per client per BOW exchange segment the firm trades on, permission YYYYYYYYYYNY (buy, sell, modify, cancel, square off for self and others; no pro orders; broadcast) when the client's segment is open and NNNNNNNNNNNY (blocked, with the reason in Remarks) when it is not registered, suspended, dormant or closed, or the client is not active. Written for clients new or changed since the last file; delete flag N. BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.

columns.name: Client ID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC

columns.name: Permission
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 12 Y/N flags: buy self, sell self, modify self, cancel self, square-off self, buy others, sell others, modify others, cancel others, square-off others, pro orders allowed, broadcast allowed

columns.name: Category
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. SECURITIES or commodities (as in BOW's samples)

columns.name: Exchange
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. BSE, NSE, MCX, NCDEX (blank in one of BOW's samples: all)

columns.name: Market
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. EQUITY, DERIVATIVE, CURRENCY, COMMODITIES

columns.name: Segment
columns.note: EQUITY for the cash market; blank = every segment of the market

columns.name: Delete Flag
columns.note: N for a new record, Y to delete the same record

linked: Live RMS → Front-office files → BOW uploads (trading rights)
